claimed_scope: Synthetic lower bound on unique FP32 partial-buffer HBM write/reread traffic under a full-producer-then-reducer phase contract, with illustrative retention and bandwidth assumptions.
assumptions: One sequence (batch size 1), one attention layer backward, one device: 4096 positions, 16 query heads, 1 KV head, dimensions 128, tile128, unique FP32 partial dK/dV per head and causal tile pair
All uncompressed partials complete before separate reduction begins, without streaming consumption or recomputation
At most 128 MiB of partials survive on chip across the complete phase boundary
Bandwidth assumptions 8 and 6.4 decimal TB/s are aggregate payload ceilings, MiB is 2^20 bytes
limitations: No GPU run or faithful attention implementation, timings or speedup
Excludes final gradient traffic, other tensors, reduction arithmetic, launches, synchronization and bandwidth inefficiency
Bound belongs only to this representation and phase contract, not all attention algorithms
128 MiB is an illustrative total retention allowance, not an actual GPU cache-size claim
